description: Draw an illustrative image of a country's standard civilian license plate (PNG shown inline, plus SVG/PNG links). The number must match the country's standard format. Official, police, military and diplomatic plates are not drawn.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. RU.

number.description: Plate number without the region, in the country's standard format.

region.description: Region code if the country shows one.

name: get_license_plate_image
title: License Plate Image
